quota.label: Listings
quota.tooltip: Active listings against your package quota

message.UNVERIFIED: Upload your trade licence to get verified — verified dealers publish instantly.
message.PENDING: We are reviewing your documents. Listings are moderated until this completes.
message.REJECTED: Your verification was rejected. Check the reason and submit again.

page.title: Verification
page.verifiedHint: Your dealership is verified — new listings publish instantly, without moderation.
page.formats: PDF, JPG, PNG or WebP — max 15 MB.
page.submitted: Licence submitted — we will review it shortly.
page.infected: The file failed the malware scan and was removed.
page.failed: The upload could not be completed.
page.ownerOnly: Only the dealership owner can submit verification documents.

onboarding.title: Set up your dealership
onboarding.hint: Create a dealer profile to manage inventory, leads and your team in one place.
onboarding.trnHint: Needed before we can invoice you. You can add it later.

empty.title: No listings yet
empty.hint: Add your first car to start receiving leads.

inventory.title: Inventory

toast.restored: Listing restored — it is paused until you resume it.

inventory.quotaBlocked: You are at your package limit. Pause a listing or upgrade to publish another.

archive.title: Remove this listing?
archive.lead: You are about to remove {{listing}}. Here is exactly what happens:

effects.offSite: It comes off the site straight away — buyers can no longer find or open it.
effects.slot: It frees one slot in your package quota, so you can publish another car.
effects.boost: Any boost running on it is cancelled, and boost credits are not refunded.
effects.restore: It stays in your Removed list for 30 days, and you can restore it from there.

archive.reasonLabel: Reason (optional — kept in your audit trail)

restore.title: Restore this listing?
restore.body: {{listing}} comes back paused, not live. Check the price and photos, then resume it when you are ready — it only takes a quota slot once it goes live again.

inventory.archivedHint: Removed listings are kept for 30 days. Restore one and it comes back paused.
inventory.draftHint: Drafts are only visible to your team. Finish one and submit it to publish.

subscription.title: Subscription
subscription.noneHint: Your listings cannot go live without one. Talk to us to get set up.
subscription.grace: Payment overdue — existing listings stay live until {{date}}
subscription.pendingPayment: Waiting for payment. Quota starts once the invoice is settled.
subscription.cancelScheduled: Cancels at the end of the term

team.title: Branches & team
team.lastBranch: A dealership must keep at least one branch.
team.lastOwner: A dealership must keep at least one owner.

empty.title: No leads yet
empty.hint: When buyers reach out about your listings, their enquiries appear here.

notes.title: Notes
notes.placeholder: Add a note for the team…

toast.failed: The action could not be completed

directory.title: Car dealers in the UAE
directory.subtitle: Verified showrooms and their live stock.

profile.noStock: This dealer has no live listings right now.

boosts.title: Boosts
boosts.none: No live boosts. Boost a listing from the inventory page.

toast.failed: The boost could not be updated

invites.title: Invitations
invites.dialogHint: They get an email with a link that works for 7 days. Anyone you invite can see this dealership’s stock.
invites.resent: A new link is on its way to {{email}} — the previous link no longer works.
invites.failed: The invitation could not be sent.
invites.notAllowed: Only an owner or manager can invite people to this dealership.

revokeConfirm.title: Revoke this invitation?
revokeConfirm.body: The link sent to {{email}} stops working immediately, and they will not be able to join. You can invite them again later.

resendConfirm.title: Send a new link?
resendConfirm.body: A fresh invitation goes to {{email}} and the expiry resets to 7 days. The link in the earlier email stops working.

plans.title: Plans
plans.hint: Pick the package you want and we will set it up for you. Nothing is charged here — we issue an invoice once we approve it.
plans.dialogBody: We will review this and come back to you. Your current listings are not affected while you wait.
plans.notePlaceholder: Start date, billing contact, a question…
plans.requested: Request sent — we will come back to you.
plans.failed: The request could not be sent.

withdrawConfirm.title: Withdraw this request?
withdrawConfirm.body: We stop reviewing it and nothing is set up. You can ask for a plan again straight away.

plans.noneOpen: You have no open plan request.

payment.title: Payments
payment.referenceHint: Put this reference on the transfer. Without it your payment arrives unattributed and cannot be matched to your account.
payment.copyFailed: Could not copy — select the text and copy it manually.
payment.missingIban: Our bank details are not published yet. Contact us and we will send them to you.
payment.declareTitle: Confirm you have sent the transfer
payment.declareBody: This tells our finance team to look out for your transfer. It is not payment: your package starts only after we confirm the money arrived.
payment.declared: Thank you — we will confirm once the transfer arrives.
payment.cancelBody: Reference {{reference}} stops being valid. If you have already sent the transfer, do not cancel — tell us instead. You can start a new payment for the same invoice afterwards.
payment.blockedTitle: We cannot take payment right now
payment.blockedBody: Nothing has been charged and you owe nothing extra. Get in touch and we will arrange it manually.
payment.pendingNotice: You told us this transfer is on its way. It is not paid until our finance team confirms it arrived.

editProfile.title: Dealership profile
editProfile.hint: This is what buyers see on your public dealer page.
editProfile.aboutHint: Shown on your public page. English — other languages are added by our team.
editProfile.trnHint: Exactly 15 digits. We cannot issue you an invoice without it.
editProfile.listHint: Type a value and press Enter to add it.
editProfile.failed: The profile could not be saved.
editProfile.readOnly: Only an owner or manager can edit the dealership profile.

logo.title: Logo
logo.hint: A square image works best. JPG, PNG or WebP.
logo.removeBody: Your dealership goes back to showing its initials everywhere the logo appears — your public page, the dealer directory and every car you list. You can upload a new one at any time.
logo.failed: The logo could not be uploaded.
logo.badType: Use a JPG, PNG or WebP image.
